_source: Cent numbers identified from the four Set diagrams in the user's 'discord cents-graphics' folder (cents.gallery media library), by matching each coin in a diagram against all 10,000 on-chain images. Every match scored 0.95-0.998 with the runner-up at 0.92 or below, and every one was then checked against metadata.json: years, mint marks and contamination types agree with the diagrams' own labels. The film shows the on-chain images of these Cents, not the diagrams. Identified 2026-10-24.
